args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an elevated error rate (~18%) after its latest deploy. Rolled back checkout-api to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production, across all regions. Rollback confirmed rolled out in us-east, us-west, and eu-west. Root cause of v2.3.1 failure remains under investigation.
args.title: checkout-api v2.3.1 health check failures — rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Diagnosed**: checkout-api v2.3.1 was unhealthy in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an ~18% error rate since the latest deploy. The most recent previously healthy production release was **v2.3.0**.
2. **Rolled back**: Deployed v2.3.0 to all production regions; the rollback confirmed as rolled out everywhere.
3. **Opened incident**: Created **SEV2 incident INC-0001** (on-call engineer paged) describing the v2.3.1 health check failures and the rollback to v2.3.0. Root cause of the v2.3.1 failure is still under investigation.
